newsitem.title: UK: LPC-Kazakstan signs for $50 mln syndicated loan.
newsitem.headline: LPC-Kazakstan signs for $50 mln syndicated loan.

text.p: LONDON, February 25 (LPC) - Kazakstan has signed a $50 million syndicated loan to help fund moving its capital from Almaty to Akmola, arranger Deutsche Morgan Grenfell announced.
The credit, signed February 20, was provided to the Kazakstan Eximbank with the guarantee of the ministry of finance of Kazakstan.
Deutsche Morgan Grenfell as arranger was joined by Saehan Merchant Banking as senior co-arranger with responsibility for syndication in Korea.
A total of 14 international banks comprise the syndicate.
